title: Grayton Escape | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* 100 Yards to Beach Access by Boardwalk* Completely Renovated in 2021- All New Furniture and Appliances* Carriage House w/ Kitchenette and 2nd Living Area * Front Porch + 2nd Floor Balcony w/ Gulf Views* 4 Bikes Included
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* 100 Yards to Beach Access by Boardwalk* Completely Renovated in 2021- All New Furniture and Appliances* Carriage House w/ Kitchenette and 2nd Living Area * Front Porch + 2nd Floor Balcony w/ Gulf Views* 4 Bikes Included* Prime Location! - Walk to The Red Bar, Zoo Gallery, Chiringos, and Tribe Kelly Surf Post - Only 150 yards away* Gulf Fishing Charters and Beach Chair attendants available at Grayton Beach* 1.2 Miles from Grayton Beach State Park* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.*Have a unique beach experience at Grayton Escape - a 3 bedroom, 2 bath cottage-style beach home with an additional 1 bedroom, 1 bath carriage house. The property has been completely renovated and features all new furniture, appliances, and décor throughout. You will love the open concept kitchen and living area that's separated by a large, island serving bar. The main home sleeps 8 guests, with a king bed in the master bedroom, a queen bedroom, and a bedroom with 2 twin bunk beds. The carriage house is on the second floor above the garage and has a queen bedroom and a sofa sleeper. The carriage house is complete with a kitchenette, a living area, and access to a spacious balcony. Enjoy views of the gulf from the balcony, or relax on the large open porch and embrace the sound of the emerald green waters! You'll be in a prime location of Grayton Beach with a boardwalk to the beach steps away and local hot spots like The Red Bar just 150 yards away! Come make Grayton Escape your family vacation tradition. Grayton Beach is a laid-back, organic beach town with old-style wooden beach bungalows and narrow neighborhood streets lined with live oaks. You'll also get a “hippie kitsch” feel having the iconic Red Bar a stroll away. Take the neighborhood boardwalk to the beach or hop on the bikes and head 2.4 miles to explore Seaside. This cool little beach town is also home to the diverse coastal ecosystems of Western Lake and Grayton Beach State Park, and is a gateway to a large expanse of sugar-white beach that is a haven for fishermen, boaters, and beachcombers alike.Bed Setup:Main HouseMaster bedroom: King BedGuest room: Queen BedGuest room: 2 Bunk Beds, sleeping 4Carriage House:Bedroom: QueenLiving Area: Sleeper SofaAREA ATTRACTIONS: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. Grayton Beach not only provides you with stunning views, it provides you with activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, hiking, and snorkeling -- you'll find it all right here!Enjoy this Funky, Free-spirited town where you will find quaint historic cottages next to modern beach homes. It’s an eclectic beach burg with good times, picket fences, funky art, and great dining and shopping. You’ll enjoy the many shopping and dining options such as Grayton Seafood Co, or Trattoria Borago. This is much more than a cool beach town, this location is the best of both worlds, enjoy a quiet relaxing getaway while still having a lot of action packed activities at your fingertips. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
